_comment: Every table and view in schema public belongs to exactly one area. The generator fails when a relation is in no area or in two, so a migration that adds a table must also place it here.

createdOutsideMigrations.schema_migrations: the migration runner (packages/db/src/migrate.ts, CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS before the first migration; ADR 0009)

areas.title: Tenancy and access
areas.about: Organizations, practices (the tenant), people, memberships and their roles, grants of practice access to other organizations, agreements, break-glass support grants, sign-in devices and sessions, the persona matrix and the PHI table registry itself.

areas.title: Documents and remittances
areas.about: Every uploaded file, and the 835 remittance loaded from it: transaction sets, claims, service lines, CAS and PLB adjustments, the minimal patient identity, the parse report, and notes a person writes on a line.

areas.title: Payers, contracts and rates
areas.about: Payers and plans as the remittances name them, the mapping of a plan to an agreement, contracts and their versions, rate records (each pricing term with its page, quote and hash), the contract calendar, and the questions a specialist raises on a version.

areas.title: Global content
areas.dictionary: Global content (no practice_id; read-only to the application role)
areas.about: Numbered rule releases and their records (fee schedule, adjustments, code lists, dispute windows), and the withdrawal of a release. No practice_id; the application role reads only.

areas.title: Pricing, triage and cases
areas.about: Pricing runs and their immutable priced lines, anomaly cohorts, the stage of each line, cases and their lines and activity, the audit report and its downloads, and the coverage report and monthly summary.

areas.title: Packets
areas.about: The dispute packet, its immutable verified versions (approval and export recorded on the version), the submissions a customer logs and the payer responses captured against them.

areas.title: Ledger
areas.about: The signed, append-only recovery ledger, the matches that pair its evidence, the posting-export and EFT-export rows it matches against, and the ROI statement.

areas.title: Model gateway
areas.about: Each model call (references and hashes only), evaluation examples, the proposals a person decides, and budget holds taken before a call.

areas.title: Billing and onboarding
areas.about: Stripe subscriptions, invoices and webhook events, the one-subscription claim, nightly usage counts and the billing standing view; the public audit request, with its attribution and decline reason, user invitations, and terms of use with their acceptances; and the free screening's prospects, uploads, platform place-of-service split, runs and aggregate results, the counts-only outcome every screening leaves, the frozen summary a converted or consenting practice keeps for 12 months, and the campaign codes the founder lists (no PHI, no practice).

areas.title: Operations
areas.about: The append-only audit log, job runs, in-app notifications and digests (counts and totals only), feature flags, mutation request keys, rate-limit counters, restore drills, the public status page, support tickets and the receipts of the support inbox, SOC 2 evidence records, and the migration ledger.
